description: SFT-only fine-tuning protocol for the exp2 tuned TIGER checkpoints (the no-reward control). Continues the init checkpoint with token cross-entropy only. This file documents the protocol implemented by the consumer scripts; their argparse defaults must match it (guarded by tests/test_finetune_protocol_configs.py).

schedule.patience_unit: validations (10 x validate_every = up to 50 stagnant epochs)

final_evaluation.init_baseline: the untouched init checkpoint is evaluated under the same protocol (variant=init)

data.note: The checkpoint's own captured data config, unchanged (yambda_50m: full last-128-targets-per-user layout, 993,926 train examples).
